name: Knowledge NeRF
definition: A framework for few-shot novel view synthesis of dynamic articulated objects that reconstructs a current state S1 using sparse inputs (5 images) by leveraging a pretrained NeRF model of a previous state S0 (knowledge base).
summary: Knowledge NeRF synthesizes novel views of dynamic objects from sparse inputs by mapping current states to a frozen pretrained NeRF knowledge base via a lightweight projection module.
